At the point (120, 120), all three boxes overlap. Since all three are positioned elements without opacity tricks or stacking contexts that would alter paint order, the browser uses z-index to determine stacking: `back` has z-index 1, `front` has z-index 2, and `middle` has z-index 3. The element with the highest z-index paints on top, so `middle` (z-index 3) is visible at that point.
